title: OpenClaw executor tool evidence probe
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/executor-contract';$out=Join-Path $root '059a-agent.json';$err=Join-Path $root '059a-agent.err.txt';Remove-Item $out,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$msg='Use an available local execution tool, shell tool, or PowerShell tool now. Create the file C:/3EN-Agent/executor-contract/delegated-marker-059a.txt with exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK as its content. You must actually execute the tool; do not only explain. Then reply exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK.';$args=@('agent','--session-key','3en-v421-059a','--message',$msg,'--json','--timeout','180');$raw=& openclaw.cmd @args 2>$err;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$txt=($raw|Out-String);$txt|Set-Content $out -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output '=== OPENCLAW_AGENT_RESPONSE ===';Write-Output $txt;if(Test-Path $err){$et=Get-Content $err -Raw;if(-not([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($et))){Write-Output '=== OPENCLAW_AGENT_STDERR ===';Write-Output $et}};if($ec -ne 0){throw ('OPENCLAW_AGENT_EXIT='+$ec)};$null=$txt|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Join-Path $root 'delegated-marker-059a.txt';if(-not(Test-Path $p)){throw 'OPENCLAW_TOOL_DID_NOT_CREATE_FILE'};if((Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim() -ne 'OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK'){throw 'OPENCLAW_TOOL_FILE_INVALID'};Write-Output 'V421_059A_EXECUTOR=PASS'
